title: When the Harbor Sings Revisited
author: Orsen Galloway
blurb: Ada Dunmore, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
